Simple Moving Average (SMA).details: Calculates the average price over a specified number of periods

inputs.name: window
inputs.description: Number of periods used to calculate SMA (Recommended: 5+)

Exponential Moving Average (EMA).details: Calculates a weighted moving average giving more importance to recent prices

inputs.name: window
inputs.description: Number of periods used to calculate EMA (Recommended: 5+)

Relative Strength Index (RSI).details: Momentum oscillator that measures the speed and magnitude of recent price changes

inputs.name: window
inputs.description: Number of periods used to calculate RSI (Common: 14)
